model: TUDOR Black Bay 58 M7939A1A0NU-0001 (39 mm steel, black dial, five-link steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Black Bay 58 template (the burgundy M7939A1A0RU-0001 changes model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, dial emission and, if the pose / hands differ, the hands section): case, bezel (insert + coin edge), crown, hands and the five-column bracelet from the 39 mm photo; the dial, indices, print and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 303 / bottoms y 944); top slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (bezel_in..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, measured on the photo (rows along each axis at 6x) plus 0.03 mm so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon, mirrored about the axis (hour: stem strip + snowflake diamond with the nub, minute: strip to a point, seconds: disc). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: no crown guards on the Black Bay 58; fluted part to x 747, rounded end cap to 755

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Flat five-column bracelet (outer, inner, centre, inner, outer brushed / polished columns, 39 mm Black Bay 58). Joints (dark lines) read from the photo with brightness scans and 4-6x crops, top and bottom separately, listed as mm from the pivot (13.8718 px/mm, pivot (451, 613)): outer joints top y 238 / 177, bottom 1025 / 1084; inner top 330 / 266.5 / 202 / 156.5, bottom 923.5 / 988.5 / 1051.5 / 1091; centre top 306.5 / 238 / 176, bottom 938 / 1027 / 1085.5. Bracelet ends y 141.5 (top) and 1123.5 (bottom). The inner and centre columns start at 18 mm, under the bezel's coin ring. bounds_x_mm = the four vertical joint lines between the columns, [|y|, x1, x2, x3, x4] (top x 388.2 / 429.5 / 470 / 512.3, bottom 388.8 / 430.5 / 469.6 / 510.6 px). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
